contingencies.urgentNoticeBody: Fiscal. retries every 30 minutes; if the DIAN still does not answer, check the issuer's contingency letter.

client.title: Which system does the issuer come through?
client.name: Name of the new system
client.secretBody: This is the only time it is shown. The system uses it to sign its calls to Fiscal.
client.webhookHint: Optional. Fiscal.'s signed notices arrive there (https).

issuer.municipalityPlaceholder: Type the name or the DANE code
issuer.municipalityHint: Search by name; the DANE code is saved.

certificate.title: Issuer's digital certificate
certificate.body: The business's certificate, from an ONAC-accredited entity, with digital signature and non-repudiation. It is validated on upload and stored encrypted.

kinds.p12: A .p12 or .pfx file with a password
kinds.pair: The certificate (.cer, .crt, .pem or .zip) and the private key (.key) as separate files

certificate.chainIncomplete: The entity's chain (intermediate and root) could not be downloaded. The certificate still signs; if the DIAN objects, upload it again when the entity's site is available.

software.title: Software registered with the DIAN
software.body: The data the habilitación portal gives when registering Fiscal. in the «Software propio» mode.
software.softwareIdHint: The DIAN creates it when Fiscal. is associated in «Configurar modos de operación».
software.pinHint: The one the business chose. It is stored encrypted.
software.testSetIdHint: It appears in the «¡Importante!» notice of the test set page.

range.title: Habilitación numbering range
range.body: Preloaded with the DIAN's habilitación range. Compare it with the «Set de pruebas Factura Electrónica» page of the portal and paste the technical key.
range.establishmentHint: If the business has several branches, the prefix is required.
range.technicalKeyHint: 40 characters. In the portal: click the field, Ctrl+A and Ctrl+C.

invoice.label: Invoicing
invoice.description: Numbering authorized by the DIAN; it needs its technical key.

contingency.label: Contingency
contingency.description: Booklet or paper for when there is no system (type 03).

done.title: Issuer enrolled
done.body: It can now run the test set from its page.
done.open: Go to the profile and run the set

onboarding.issuerDone: The issuer is already enrolled. Its data is corrected from its profile.
onboarding.clientDone: The client system is already chosen.

testSet.title: DIAN test set
testSet.error: The action could not be completed.
testSet.noRun: The set has not been run yet.
testSet.body: Use the counts the habilitación catalog shows for your TestSetId. Invoices go first; once the DIAN accepts them, the notes follow, each one on an accepted invoice. Fiscal. checks the result every 2 minutes.
testSet.sizeHint: Use the «Total de documentos requeridos» of the test set page in the DIAN portal.

production.title: Move to production
production.body: Once the DIAN accepts the set and the business is «Habilitado» in the portal (and has requested its numbering in MUISCA), its documents take fiscal effect.
production.confirm: I confirm the business is already «Habilitado» in the DIAN portal and set its start date. From now on its documents have fiscal effect.
production.done: In production: its documents have fiscal effect.
production.inProduction: In production: its documents have fiscal effect.
production.outsideBody: the business marks «Habilitado» in the DIAN portal (irreversible date; talk to the accountant first) and asks for its numbering in MUISCA.

hints.test_set_accepted: The DIAN must accept the test set.
hints.software: Usually the same SoftwareID and PIN as habilitación.
hints.range: Bring it from the DIAN once the business associated it with the software.
hints.gateway: It is a server setting (DIAN_GATEWAY=soap), not something of the business.

production.confirmHint: From then on its documents have fiscal effect.
production.promoteHint: It turns on when every requirement is ready.
production.adminOnly: Only an administrator can move the issuer to production.

ui.errorBody: The service did not answer in time. What already loaded stays on screen.

clientSystem.subtitle: Created on {date}
clientSystem.inactiveNotice: It is deactivated: it cannot call the API nor receive notices.
clientSystem.activateBody: It can call the API again with its current secret and receive notices.
clientSystem.deactivateBody: It can no longer call the API: it cannot issue documents nor enrol issuers, and it receives no notices. Its issuers and documents are kept.
clientSystem.actionFailed: The action could not be completed.
clientSystem.guideTitle: Connect the system, step by step
clientSystem.guideSubtitle: What the client system needs to work with Fiscal.

steps.secret: Secret saved in the client system
steps.secretHint: It was shown only once when created or rotated. If it was lost, rotate the secret.
steps.webhookHint: Signed notices of documents and alerts arrive there.
steps.pingHint: Send a test notice to check the URL and the signature verification.
steps.issuers: {count, plural, =0 {No issuer enrolled} one {# issuer enrolled} other {# issuers enrolled}}
steps.issuersHint: Each business enrols with its certificate and its DIAN registration.

clientSystem.pingOk: The client system received the test notice
clientSystem.pingFailed: The client system did not answer the test notice
clientSystem.pingError: Failed: {error}. Check the URL and that the system accepts the notice.
clientSystem.docsHint: How to sign calls and verify notices: docs/fiscal/contrato.md (with examples in Python and JavaScript).
clientSystem.webhookDialogBody: Fiscal. signs each notice with the current secret; the client system must verify the signature before trusting it.
clientSystem.webhookHint: https recommended. Leave it empty to receive no notices.
clientSystem.noSecrets: It has no valid secret: it cannot call the API. Rotate the secret.
clientSystem.rotateBody: A new secret is issued. The current one keeps working during the grace period, so the client system can switch without downtime. Notices are signed with the new one from now on.
clientSystem.grace: Grace period of the current secret
clientSystem.graceHint: How long the current secret keeps working.
clientSystem.graceOption: {hours, plural, =0 {No grace: it stops now} one {# hour} other {# hours}}
clientSystem.secretOnceBody: This is the only time it is shown. The previous one keeps working {hours, plural, =0 {only until now} one {# hour} other {# hours}}.
clientSystem.deliveriesSubtitle: Every signed notice Fiscal. sent, with its result.
clientSystem.deliveriesError: We could not load the notices.
clientSystem.noDeliveries: There are no notices in that state.
clientSystem.requeued: {count, plural, one {# notice back in the queue} other {# notices back in the queue}}

users.title: Users
users.subtitle: Who enters the console and what they can do.
users.adminOnly: Only an administrator can see and change users.
users.error: We could not load the users.
users.emptyBody: Invite the people who operate Fiscal.
users.inviteBody: They get an e-mail with a link and a code to choose their password. The code expires in 72 hours.

roleHints.operator: Runs the console: documents, issuers, enrolments, alerts and client systems.
roleHints.admin: Also manages users, rotates secrets, deactivates issuers and systems, and moves issuers to production.

users.invitedNoMail: The account for {email} was created, but the e-mail did not go out. Resend the invitation later.
users.makeAdminBody: They will manage users, rotate secrets, deactivate issuers and systems, and move issuers to production.
users.makeOperatorBody: They will no longer manage users, secrets, deactivations nor the move to production.
users.deactivateBody: They will not be able to enter the console again. What they did stays recorded.
users.activateBody: They can enter again with their password.
users.failed: The action could not be completed.
